status: Pan-East-Asian comparative sample; Chinese regional/historical classification not established. Two selected upper material regions are not two independent sources.

samples.label: Twin manor taller wing selected upper roof
samples.interpretation: Three continuous vertical wood segments across 16 blocks of height; may pass through storeys and beams, not a proven single-floor column height. Upper roof crop excludes most lower eave and boundary overlap.

samples.label: Twin manor perpendicular side wing selected upper roof
samples.interpretation: Selected four-column row with 5,5,5 spacing; 12-block continuous wood segments. Partial row, not the complete width bay count; selected roof joins the taller wing near its north edge.
